paper_metadata.title: Altered white matter microstructure in patients with post-stroke depression detected by diffusion kurtosis imaging

quips_assessment.risk_reasoning: The study provides clear inclusion/exclusion criteria and describes the source population (hospitalized patients). However, it is a small convenience sample (n=38 patients) and does not report the total number of eligible patients or the participation rate, making it difficult to rule out selection bias.

quips_assessment.risk_reasoning: While the study measured several confounders (age, NIHSS, HCY) and found no baseline differences, it failed to perform multivariable adjustment. The analysis relied on univariable comparisons (ANOVA/Chi-square), which does not account for the independent effect of the prognostic factors while controlling for other variables.
